cand.title: EPFL / Swiss Plasma Center
cand.excerpt: Territory TERRITORY_STRETCH: Lausanne / cross-border — stretch territory; lodging access must be proven. Lodging access for YOTEL is not evidenced, so it is not assumed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified host-side commercial-routing contacts: Yves Martin, 2027 Local Organising Committee member and identified as LOC chair in EPS-PPD board minutes; EPFL SPC Head of Administration / Member of the Direction. Dace Picot-Stiebrina, 2027 Local Organising Committee member; EPFL directory lists Dace Stiebrina, Administrative Assistant, SPC Administration, with the same published email. They are appropriate contacts to establish the accommodation decision-maker; neither is proven to control hotel contracts. Shared LOC inbox: epsplasma2027@epfl.ch.
findings.futureEdition: Official upcoming edition: 53rd EPS Conference on Plasma Physics, 5–9 July 2027, SwissTech Convention Center, Lausanne, Switzerland. Actual conference dates are stated on both the event homepage and EPFL Indico, not inferred from publication dates. Within the requested horizon. The EPS-PPD annual report dated 8 June 2026 also assigns local organisation of the 2028 edition to Laboratori Nazionali del Sud in Taormina, Italy; no exact 2028 dates or named venue were located, so it cannot be placed within the horizon ending June 2028.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification: low fit for the main congress and unproven lodging fit. A 237-room Founex hotel with approximately 250 theatre seats cannot replace the booked Lausanne congress venue; board planning cites an 800-seat extendable plenary and a 650–700 participant financial break-even, neither a confirmed attendance forecast. A smaller delegated subgroup or airport-side pre/post stay could be explored, but no demand or transfer arrangement for that role is published. Any 20–120-room discussion is only the supplied commercial screening band, not an event room requirement. This is an urban/campus congress rather than a resort-retreat brief.
findings.venueCommitments: Confirmed meeting venue: SwissTech Convention Center, Quartier Nord EPFL, Route Louis-Favre 2, 1024 Ecublens, Canton of Vaud, Switzerland; marketed by the conference as Lausanne. Territory classification: Lausanne / western Lausanne, not Founex, Nyon, La Côte, Geneva Airport corridor or Geneva city. The official conference page says it “will be held” there; EPS-PPD board minutes explicitly say “The venue, which has now been booked, will be the SwissTech Convention Center.” This is a convention centre commitment, not a hotel-room commitment.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified annual rotating series: Salamanca, Spain, 8–12 July 2024, Palacio de Congresos; Vilnius, Lithuania, 7–11 July 2025, Radisson Blu Hotel Lietuva; Edinburgh, UK, 29 June–3 July 2026, Edinburgh International Conference Centre; Lausanne, Switzerland, 5–9 July 2027, SwissTech Convention Center. The 2026 annual report names Taormina/Laboratori Nazionali del Sud for 2028 but supplies no exact dates or venue. Annual recurrence does not mean annual Lausanne demand.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing unconfirmed. No edition-specific hotel list, hotel booking link, room block, housing bureau, PCO or open hotel RFP was found on the reviewed official 2027 pages. Every edition-specific hotel listed: none found. Indico states: “For other information (travel, accommodation, lunches, social activities, ...) please visit the conference website.” Board minutes provide a planning target, not a contracted rate: “the target room rate is €100 – €120 per night”; they also record advice to examine accommodation costs and a question about cheap student housing, which Yves Martin agreed to investigate. There is no evidence that housing is open, allocated to YOTEL, or committed to named competing hotels.
findings.organizationStructure: Scientific society conference under the auspices of the European Physical Society, associated with its Plasma Physics Division; 2027 local host/organising institution is EPFL through the Swiss Plasma Center, part of EPFL’s School of Basic Sciences. This is an academic/scientific-society path, not evidence of an agency-owned corporate event. SwissTech is the meeting venue, not the event owner or proven housing buyer. No 2027 PCO/DMC or housing agency identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Venue relocation is not an available evidenced opportunity because SwissTech is booked. No named 2027 incumbent hotel, sold-out condition, overflow requirement or hotel shortage was identified. The published planning target of €100–€120 per night and investigation of student housing signal price sensitivity, not an agreed accommodation tariff. Venue access information favours the Lausanne/Renens M1 network; it does not establish a Founex hotel transfer. The Radisson in Vilnius was a historical host venue, not a 2027 incumbent.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Yves Martin first, copying Dace Picot-Stiebrina or the LOC inbox, to ask who controls 2027 accommodation sourcing; whether hotels/student residences or a bureau are already appointed; whether an airport-side subgroup is actually required; room nights/peak rooms, acceptable net rate and transfer budget. Reference the documented room-rate target without treating it as current agreed pricing. Offer only a conditional smaller block within the supplied 20–120-room guidance after transport feasibility and budget are established. Do not quote a whole-house congress package or claim overflow. If there is no Founex-specific lodging need, retain a low-priority institutional relationship rather than promote a sales-ready 2027 lead.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, access is limited to an exploratory LOC enquiry: no verified purchasable room block or accommodation RFP. Geneva Airport-to-Lausanne rail access is documented in the board minutes and local M1 access on the venue page, but neither proves practical or booked lodging access from YOTEL Founex. Do not qualify it as automatic airport-corridor overflow.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: maintain a selective EPFL/SPC relationship for genuinely smaller meetings or a specifically requested airport-side subgroup, rather than assuming this congress returns to Lausanne annually. Rotation is established and the annual report assigns 2028 local organisation to Taormina. No future YOTEL capture, room inventory or smaller EPFL programme has been verified in this investigation.
